design_overview: A clean, modern task management application designed with clarity and usability at its core. The interface uses a card-based layout with strong visual hierarchy, making task creation, completion, and management intuitive. The design follows mobile-first principles with touch-friendly components, clear call-to-action buttons, and smooth navigation patterns. The color scheme promotes focus and productivity while maintaining visual comfort for extended use.

screens.name: Task List Home
screens.purpose: Primary screen displaying all active tasks with quick actions for task management and creation

key_components.name: App Header
key_components.styling: White background with subtle bottom shadow, 60px height, contains app title 'My Tasks' in bold 28px text and user profile icon on right
key_components.interaction: Static header, profile icon navigates to Profile screen

key_components.name: Filter Tabs
key_components.styling: Horizontal tab bar below header with two tabs: 'Active' (selected, primary color underline) and 'All', 48px height, white background
key_components.interaction: Tapping 'Active' shows incomplete tasks, 'All' shows all tasks

key_components.name: Task Count Badge
key_components.styling: Small rounded badge showing '5 tasks' in gray text, positioned below tabs with 16px padding
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive, displays current task count

key_components.name: Task Card 1
key_components.styling: White card with 16px padding, 12px rounded corners, subtle shadow, contains checkbox (unchecked), task title 'Complete project proposal' in bold 16px, description 'Draft and finalize the Q4 proposal document' in gray 14px, timestamp 'Created 2 hours ago' in light gray 12px
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to Task Detail screen, tapping checkbox marks task complete

key_components.name: Task Card 2
key_components.styling: White card with 16px padding, 12px rounded corners, subtle shadow, contains checkbox (unchecked), task title 'Review team feedback' in bold 16px, description 'Go through all feedback from yesterday meeting' in gray 14px, timestamp 'Created 5 hours ago' in light gray 12px
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to Task Detail screen, tapping checkbox marks task complete

key_components.name: Task Card 3
key_components.styling: White card with 16px padding, 12px rounded corners, subtle shadow, contains checkbox (unchecked), task title 'Update documentation' in bold 16px, description 'Add new API endpoints to developer docs' in gray 14px, timestamp 'Created yesterday' in light gray 12px
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to Task Detail screen, tapping checkbox marks task complete

key_components.name: Empty State Message
key_components.styling: Centered text 'No tasks yet. Create your first task!' in gray 16px, only visible when task list is empty
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive informational text

key_components.name: Create Task FAB
key_components.styling: Circular floating action button, 56px diameter, primary color background with white plus icon, positioned bottom-right with 24px margin, elevated shadow
key_components.interaction: Tapping opens Create Task screen

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation
key_components.styling: White background with top border, 64px height, three evenly spaced items with icons and labels: Tasks (selected, primary color), Completed (gray), Profile (gray)
key_components.interaction: Tapping each item navigates to respective screen

screens.user_flow: Entry point of app. Users view their active tasks, can tap cards to see details, check boxes to complete tasks, or tap FAB to create new task. Bottom nav allows switching to Completed or Profile screens.

screens.name: Create Task
screens.purpose: Modal screen for creating a new task with title and description inputs

key_components.name: Modal Header
key_components.styling: White background, 56px height, contains 'New Task' title centered in bold 20px, close button (X) on left
key_components.interaction: Close button dismisses modal and returns to Task List

key_components.name: Title Input
key_components.styling: White input field with light gray border, 48px height, 12px rounded corners, placeholder 'Task title *' in gray, 16px padding, required field indicator
key_components.interaction: Tapping activates keyboard for text entry, displays error border if submitted empty

key_components.name: Title Character Count
key_components.styling: Right-aligned gray text '0/255' below title input, 12px font size
key_components.interaction: Updates dynamically as user types

key_components.name: Description Input
key_components.styling: White multiline textarea with light gray border, 120px height, 12px rounded corners, placeholder 'Add description (optional)' in gray, 16px padding
key_components.interaction: Tapping activates keyboard for multiline text entry

key_components.name: Description Character Count
key_components.styling: Right-aligned gray text '0/1000' below description input, 12px font size
key_components.interaction: Updates dynamically as user types

key_components.name: Error Message
key_components.styling: Red text 'Title is required' in 14px, only visible when validation fails, positioned below title input
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive error feedback

key_components.name: Cancel Button
key_components.styling: Secondary button with light gray background, 48px height, full width minus 32px margin, 12px rounded corners, 'Cancel' text in dark gray 16px
key_components.interaction: Dismisses modal without saving, returns to Task List

key_components.name: Create Button
key_components.styling: Primary button with primary color background, 48px height, full width minus 32px margin, 12px rounded corners, 'Create Task' text in white 16px bold, positioned above Cancel button with 12px gap
key_components.interaction: Validates inputs, creates task if valid, shows success message and returns to Task List with new task visible

key_components.name: Keyboard Spacer
key_components.styling: Dynamic spacing that adjusts when keyboard appears to keep buttons visible
key_components.interaction: Automatically adjusts layout when keyboard shows/hides

screens.user_flow: Accessed from Task List via FAB. Users enter task title (required) and optional description, then tap Create to save or Cancel to dismiss. On successful creation, returns to Task List with new task at top.

screens.name: Task Detail
screens.purpose: Detailed view of a single task with options to edit, complete, or delete

key_components.name: Detail Header
key_components.styling: White background with bottom shadow, 56px height, back arrow on left, 'Task Details' title centered in bold 20px, edit icon on right
key_components.interaction: Back arrow returns to Task List, edit icon navigates to Edit Task screen

key_components.name: Task Title Display
key_components.styling: Bold 24px text displaying task title 'Complete project proposal', dark text color, 24px top padding, 16px horizontal padding
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive display text

key_components.name: Task Metadata
key_components.styling: Gray 14px text showing 'Created 2 hours ago', 8px top margin, 16px horizontal padding
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive timestamp

key_components.name: Description Section
key_components.styling: White card with light gray background, 16px padding, 12px rounded corners, contains 'Description' label in bold 16px and description text 'Draft and finalize the Q4 proposal document' in regular 16px, 24px top margin
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive content display

key_components.name: Status Badge
key_components.styling: Rounded badge with light blue background, 'Active' text in primary color, 8px padding, inline with metadata
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive status indicator

key_components.name: Mark Complete Button
key_components.styling: Success color background button, 48px height, full width minus 32px margin, 12px rounded corners, white checkmark icon and 'Mark as Complete' text in white 16px bold
key_components.interaction: Marks task as completed, shows confirmation toast, updates status badge, navigates back to Task List

key_components.name: Delete Button
key_components.styling: Outlined button with error color border, 48px height, full width minus 32px margin, 12px rounded corners, error color trash icon and 'Delete Task' text in error color 16px, positioned below complete button with 12px gap

key_components.name: Action Divider
key_components.styling: Horizontal line in light gray, 1px height, 24px vertical margin, separates content from action buttons
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive visual separator

key_components.name: Bottom Safe Area
key_components.styling: 24px bottom padding to ensure buttons are above device safe area
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive spacing element

screens.user_flow: Accessed by tapping a task card from Task List. Users can read full task details, mark complete, edit (via header icon), or delete. Back button returns to Task List. Completing or deleting also returns to Task List with updated data.

key_components.name: Completed Task Card 2

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation
key_components.styling: White background with top border, 64px height, three evenly spaced items: Tasks (gray), Completed (selected, primary color), Profile (gray)

screens.user_flow: Accessed via bottom navigation from Task List. Users view all completed tasks with completion timestamps, can tap cards to view details, or clear all completed tasks. Bottom nav allows switching to Tasks or Profile screens.

screens.user_flow: Triggered when user taps Delete button on Task Detail screen. Users must confirm or cancel deletion. Confirming removes task and returns to Task List. Canceling returns to Task Detail screen with no changes.

responsive_design: Mobile-first design optimized for 375px-428px width screens. All touch targets minimum 44px for accessibility. Cards and buttons scale proportionally on larger screens. Bottom navigation remains fixed. Content areas scroll independently. Modals center on screen with max-width constraints. Landscape mode maintains usability with adjusted spacing.
accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant. Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for text. All interactive elements have 44px minimum touch target. Screen reader labels on all icons and buttons. Focus indicators visible on all interactive elements. Error messages clearly associated with inputs. Semantic HTML structure. Keyboard navigation support for web version.
animations: Subtle micro-interactions throughout. Button press: 100ms scale down to 0.95. Screen transitions: 300ms slide with ease-out. Modal appearance: 250ms fade with scale from 0.9. Toast notifications: 300ms slide up. Checkbox toggle: 200ms with bounce effect. List item press: 150ms background color fade. FAB press: ripple effect. All animations respect reduced motion preferences.
icons: Consistent icon set using outlined style. Icons used: home (tasks list), bookmark (completed tasks), user (profile), plus (create task), edit (edit action), trash (delete action), bell (notifications), settings (preferences), filter (task filtering), search (future feature), share (future feature), heart (future feature). All icons 24px size, stroke width 2px, rounded line caps.
